messages.subject: Alternative install directory in Linux
parts:
I am trying to install R on my new Linux Cluster and need to install it in the image directory on the head node in order to push it to the other nodes.

How can I do this?  This is very important.

Roger

messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: Alternative install directory in Linux
parts:
Hello,

The files are relocatable. If you do a regular installation of RRO, you should be able to copy those files over to your image directory without issue. Please let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Josée
